name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major cloud or payments outage found since Apple's on 17 Nov; officials say the US outage wave was not an attack
state: A run of US outages from 12 to 17 Nov hit Microsoft 365, the FAA, AWS us-east-1 (over three hours on 15 Nov), Chase on 16 Nov and Apple services including Apple Pay on 17 Nov (Fox News, 19 Nov). Since then only smaller incidents were found; US officials said the outages were separate technical failures, not coordinated cyberattacks (ABC13). With no major cloud, CDN or payments outage over 2h in the 48h to 20 Nov, the level returns to Normal.
for_you: Major cloud and payment services are running normally. Provider status pages give the most reliable updates if services fail; outages in recent weeks were resolved within about a day.
rubric_hit: No major multi-hour cloud/CDN/payments outage in the past 48h (Normal); Apple outage 17 Nov falls outside the window

sources.title: Fox News — Trump admin urges calm after wave of tech outages
ABC13 — Tech outage live updates: Apple, JPMorgan Chase and other services

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
